agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Wednesday, February 11, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
a.
Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department - Introduction of Sheriff's Deputy Lomita Station
b.
Employee Recognition Award - Safety
c.
Lomita Library - Community Room Expansion Project
Presented by Fred Hungerford, Chief Deputy County Librarian & Scott Carde, Architect
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting held on January 28, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Resolution 2015-06, Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #7c
d.
Monthly Report for the Administrative Services Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7d
e.
Monthly Report for City Manager's Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7e
f.
Monthly Report for Community Development Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7f
g.
Monthly Report for Parks and Recreation Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7g
h.
Monthly Report for the Public Works Department.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7h
i.
December 2014 Treasurer's Report.
ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
Ordinance No. 773 - An Ordinance of the City of the City Council of the City of Lomita, amending in its entirety Chapter 8 of Title VI of the Lomita Municipal Code related to Massage Businesses.
ACTION: That said ordinance be adopted.
Item #7j
k.
Resolution No. 2015-07 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California establishing fees for massage businesses including application fee, renewal fees, and appeal fees.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted.
Item #7k
l.
Resolution No. 2015-08 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita expressing firm support for the Los Angeles Air Force Base (LAAFB) and stating that any relocation attempt of the Space and Missile Systems Center (SMC) would be detrimental to national defense and the mission of the Los Angeles Air Force Base.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted.
SCHEDULED ITEM:
Item #7l
8.
RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE 2014 GENERAL PLAN ADVISORY COMMITTEE (GPAC) ACTION :That the City Council: 1) receive a presentation from the GPAC and 2) direct staff to meet with the Economic Development Ad Hoc Committee to further analyze GPAC recommendations and report back to Council at a future date.
Presented by GPAC Chair Bob Steinbach
Item #8
PUBLIC HEARING:
9.
PUBLIC HEARING AND CONSIDERATION OF A RATE RESOLUTION RELATIVE TO WATER RATES ACTION: That City Council: 1) Conduct a public hearing and receive written protests from property owners in accordance with Proposition 218 relative to the proposed water rate increase and 2) If a majority protest is not achieved, adopt the attached Water Rate Resolution No. 2015-09.
Resolution No. 2015-09 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita adopting new water rates and charges.
Item #9
10.
ADJOURNMENT The next regular meeting of the Lomita City Council will be on February 25, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
9.
PUBLIC HEARING AND CONSIDERATION OF A RATE RESOLUTION RELATIVE TO WATER RATES ACTION: That City Council: 1) Conduct a public hearing and receive written protests from property owners in accordance with Proposition 218 relative to the proposed water rate increase and 2) If a majority protest is not achieved, adopt the attached Water Rate Resolution No. 2015-09.
Resolution No. 2015-09 - A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita adopting new water rates and charges.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
